author: Oscar Levin
scope: Full Chapter1 opening and complete Section1.1 with both active exercise includes; six separately identified fixed cached snapshots. Not the whole chapter or book.

existing_notice_policy.status: Retain the already audited B10 work/component policy; no new supply/license audit or image-specific clearance decision.
existing_notice_policy.work_level: Existing Indonesian LICENSE explicitly follows active fourth-edition CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 frontmatter while retaining stale upstream root BY-SA 4.0 discrepancy.
existing_notice_policy.authors_and_nonendorsement: Identify Oscar Levin and the English fourth edition; identify changes; no endorsement by Oscar Levin or University of Northern Colorado.
existing_notice_policy.components: Current B10-002 contains six authored WeBWorK owners and six pinned static cache records: four remote OPL references and two local PG sources. Retain their component notices and exact identity evidence. No PreTeXt/Runestone runtime, grading or randomization is included.
existing_notice_policy.publication_claims: The comparison README's complete-book/613-page/243-WeBWorK claims describe the Indonesian release, not the future Punjabi opening.

historical_scope_context.components_verbatim: Retain THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES for WeBWorK OPL and PreTeXt/Runestone software when those components are actually used. The proposed chapter contains zero WeBWorK elements; do not import the entire OPL for it.
historical_scope_context.qualification: The inherited zero-WeBWorK sentence concerned the earlier proposed opening/Chapter0, not B10-002. It is retained here solely as historical evidence and is not the current component inventory.

existing_notice_input_hash_policy: Existing raw and logical CRLF-to-LF hashes checked separately in memory; no notice rewritten.

selected_component_witnesses.scope: Seven exact-byte witnesses: root OPL_LICENSE, four selected original English OPL PG files and two original local DMOI PG files. Not the complete OPL library/public provenance package.
selected_component_witnesses.notice_policy: Retain the existing OPL default CC BY-NC-SA 3.0 Unported notice and its unless-otherwise-indicated/alternative-license clauses verbatim. Existing active fourth-edition book notices remain separate; this is not a new rights assessment.
selected_component_witnesses.execution_policy: Witness text is inert and never executed; four original OPL files were fetched at the already pinned OPL commit, two local PG blobs copied from pinned DMOI Git. No claim that a cache snapshot exhausts its source variants.

# Third-party notices

## WeBWorK Open Problem Library

The interactive edition contains adapted problem files obtained from the
WeBWorK Open Problem Library at commit
`521448225da9a2dc4ebf1ed6258f7afe2f1b5eac`. The OPL notice states that,
unless otherwise indicated, copyrights are held by the contributing authors
and contributions are licensed under CC BY-NC-SA 3.0 Unported; contributors
may instead specify another OSI-approved license.

The exact upstream paths, blob identities, target hashes, acquisition receipts,
and the verbatim `OPL_LICENSE` are included in the public provenance package.
The Indonesian adaptations retain the applicable component attribution,
NonCommercial, and ShareAlike conditions.

## PreTeXt and Runestone output

The HTML reader includes generated runtime assets from PreTeXt and Runestone.
Those software assets retain their upstream notices and licenses. Their
presence does not change the CC license governing the book content.

## Images and authored assets

Images and diagrams inherited from Oscar Levin's fourth-edition repository are
treated as components of that book under its active CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 notice,
unless a file carries a more specific notice. Source identities and exact
hashes are retained in the editable-source and provenance packages.

component_limit: Existing component restrictions remain binding. Cache or blob identity is not new permission or a claim covering all generated variants.

math_conversion.spacing_policy: All raw whitespace survives exact TeX/annotation and reversible token ledgers; literal mtext uses white-space:pre. ASCII minus maps to U+2212 with token evidence.
